g.text: Change one node in a loaded spec file. 'at' is a JSONPath naming exactly one node -- reuse the
expression spec-query already gave you for it, don't guess a fresh one. 'value' is YAML for the
replacement ('mode': 'set', the default) or one new item ('mode': 'append', only if 'at' addresses
a list). A person reviews the exact diff before anything is written -- show them, in your own
reply, what you're about to change and why before calling this, the same as before
/command · ! shell · Tab switch pane · → complete · Ctrl+P palette · /quit
